claims: Maintain continuous hemodynamic monitoring with arterial line and PA catheter, given borderline MAP (60 mmHg), low SvO2 (59-61%), and vasoactive infusions.
Continue mechanical ventilatory support with lung-protective settings and monitor ABG trends (pH 7.32-7.36, pCO2 36-43, pO2 105-185).
Continue phenylephrine infusion to support MAP and titrate to institutional target, reassessing perfusion and lactate.
Continue insulin infusion and monitor blood glucose at least hourly, targeting 140-180 mg/dL given recent glucose 118-140 mg/dL.
Monitor lactate trend (declining 4.3 to 2.4 mmol/L) and base excess to assess resuscitation adequacy.
Continue analgesia/sedation with fentanyl PCA and target RASS 0 to -1, reassessing pain and sedation at least every 4 hours.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit (Hb 8.4-10.4 g/dL) and transfuse packed red blood cells if Hb falls below 7 g/dL or if symptomatic/ischemic, per restrictive strategy.
Replete electrolytes: continue magnesium replacement (Mg 1.4-1.8 mg/dL) and potassium replacement (K 3.8-4.5 mEq/L), rechecking levels after replacement.
Perform daily spontaneous awakening and breathing trials when clinically appropriate (currently CPAP/PSV with spontaneous breaths), assessing readiness for extubation.
Implement VTE prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin and continue sequential compression devices if not contraindicated.
